verdict.rationale: Application deadlines and penalties for missing them are a fair question for an immigration authority, so the axis applies. The pack gives an application timing window (up to 3 months before the work start date) and exact application fees. It publishes no filing deadline with consequences and no penalty or interest schedule with figures, so it does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
